lines.zh: 巢穴的枝条随着我移动。
lines.en: The nest's branches move with me.
I drag a crimson wet trail.
Not fast, but nothing stops it.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下红色的坑。
lines.en: Red hollows are left wherever I pass.
I patrol my own perilous nest.
My limbs grope along the ground.
Red fluid drips without pause.

lines.zh: 整片林子都在我的阴影里。
lines.en: The whole grove falls in my shadow.

lines.zh: 我走向声音最大的地方。
lines.en: I walk toward the loudest sound.
Behind me lies my crawling trail.
I stand like a mountain of flesh.

lines.zh: 巢里的薄膜在轻轻鼓动。
lines.en: The membranes in my nest pulse softly.

lines.zh: 我在消化上一次的猎物。
lines.en: Digesting the last catch.

lines.zh: 殷红的东西还在往下滴。
lines.en: The crimson stuff keeps dripping.
This ground has changed color.

lines.zh: 我在听有多少活物靠近。
lines.en: Listening to how many living things approach.
My breathing makes the air tacky.
For now I needn't move.
The nest slowly closes around me.
Another small piece has grown.
The mud beneath is stained black.
Waiting for a good moment.
This grove will be mine.

lines.zh: 我的身体从内部在翻动。
lines.en: Something turns over inside me.
Nothing yet has made me rise.
Stillness makes me hungrier.
You stand at the edge of my nest.
You carry warmth.
I smell which way your blood flows.

lines.zh: 你的个子在我眼里很小。
lines.en: You look very small to me.
You shouldn't have come this far.

lines.zh: 你的血味我已经存进巢里。
lines.en: I've stored the smell of your blood in the nest.
Counting my branches, are you?

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就知道你怕。
lines.en: One step back tells me you're afraid.

lines.zh: 你身上带着别人家的灰。
lines.en: You carry another household's ash on you.

lines.zh: 我会先吃掉叫得最响的。
lines.en: I eat the loudest one first.
That weapon is far too small.

lines.zh: 我从你鞋底看到你的喉咙。
lines.en: I read you from your boots up to your throat.
A branch broke. It'll regrow.
I withdrew a little, then pressed back.

lines.zh: 红色的液体流得更多了。
lines.en: More crimson is flowing now.
That cut into my shell.
My nest is tightening.
Pain only makes me hungrier.

lines.zh: 我听见自己内部的声音。
lines.en: I hear sounds inside myself.
Think that finishes it?
I can regenerate again.

lines.zh: 这点伤不足以让我倒下。
lines.en: This isn't enough to bring me down.
Living is better. Dead will do.
That won't fill my stomach.
You're holding it too high.
I don't eat anything clean.
I prefer it when it struggles.
On the ground, then run.
That smell reminds me of the nest.
I eat anything. Including you.
You eat first. I'll wait.

lines.zh: 一点食物换来一条命吗？
lines.en: A little food for a life?
You hit my branches.
Press close and you'll be stained red.
I'm too heavy to push.
You're stuck. Don't pull.
My body is spreading outward.

lines.zh: 再靠近，会被枝条卷进去。
lines.en: Any closer and the branches will take you.

lines.zh: 你的脚陷进了我的巢泥。
lines.en: Your foot sinks into my nest mud.
I shift half a step and you yield.

lines.zh: 我的枝条顶得你退了两步。
lines.en: My tendrils shove you back two steps.

lines.zh: 我碰到的东西都会变湿。
lines.en: Whatever I touch turns wet.
We multiply through the nest.
I only grow larger, never pair.
You're asking a land question.
My kind continues through nests.

lines.zh: 我体内只有消化与生长。
lines.en: Inside me is only digestion and growth.
Those words mean nothing to me.
The nest is all I am.
Don't speak of it before me.
I want territory, not a partner.
Ask when you grow branches.
I'm taking this thing.
I curl a branch around it.
Too small to fill anything.
It will become part of the nest.
Wet things are easier to hold.
I don't bend. My branches do.
This body is growing heavier.
Drag it into the nest.
It's taken my color now.
Picking it up isn't wasted effort.
Finding you was easier than I expected.

lines.zh: 你跑到哪儿我都闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell you anywhere.
The nest needs more nourishment.
I'll close your way out first.
You're standing dead center.

lines.zh: 我慢慢过去，你不用等太久。
lines.en: I'm coming. You won't wait long.
Your chest is beating faster than before.

lines.zh: 我等你走进来，等得枝条发痒。
lines.en: I've waited for you to walk in, until my branches itch.

lines.zh: 这片林子里没有第二个人来。
lines.en: No one else is coming to this grove.

lines.zh: 你一进来，就已经在我圈里。
lines.en: You stepped in, and you're already inside my ring.
My branches are already moving.
I press in. You can't slip away.

lines.zh: 你身上的暖意正朝我过来。
lines.en: Your warmth is coming toward me.
I'll take you back to the nest.

lines.zh: 猎物不该站在这里不动。
lines.en: Prey shouldn't stand so still.

lines.zh: 你的喉咙动了一下，我听见了。
lines.en: Your throat moved, and I heard it.
The muck will slow your feet.

lines.zh: 我伸出去的东西比你想的多。
lines.en: I reach farther than you think.
Still trying to run back?
I follow your scent.
Branches close at your feet.

lines.zh: 你的动作我看得很清楚。
lines.en: I see your movements clearly.
Another step back and you're at the water.
No hurry. I'm very large.

lines.zh: 你砍我的枝条，还有更多。
lines.en: Cut my branches — there are more.

lines.zh: 地面在我的重量下呻吟。
lines.en: The ground groans under me.
Lifting your feet costs you more.
I leave a wet trail behind me.

lines.zh: 你身上的红色越来越明显。
lines.en: The red on you is spreading.
You can't circle around this grove.

lines.zh: 我用枝条封住那两个缺口。
lines.en: My branches seal both gaps.
Your breathing gets nearer.

lines.zh: 我不需要眼睛也能追你。
lines.en: I don't need eyes to follow you.
You've backed against the roots.

lines.zh: 这会是一场很长的追猎。
lines.en: This will be a long hunt.
Each of my steps costs you one.
Don't expect the grove to help you.

lines.zh: 我把你逼到我能及的地方。
lines.en: I'm herding you into my reach.
Every branch comes down.
My whole body bears down.
This one carries acid.
Got your ankle.
Crimson splashes over you.
Don't block. You can't.
I drag you toward the nest.

lines.zh: 你砍断了一根，还有三根。
lines.en: You cut one — there are three more.
This strikes your chest.
My branches wrap your hands.

lines.zh: 枝条砸下去，泥里多了个窝。
lines.en: The branches come down and leave a hollow in the mud.
Your armor has split.
One more and you won't walk.
I smell your wound.
I've been woken from the nest.

lines.zh: 枝条先立起来，然后是我。
lines.en: The branches rise first, then me.
The color of this ground has changed.
I spread out and take more room.
The perilous nest unfolds beneath me.
Damp rises from the soil.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，林子安静了。
lines.en: I cry out, and the grove goes quiet.
Looking for the nearest water.
This body is a new nest.

lines.zh: 红色从我的缝隙里渗出。
lines.en: Red seeps from my seams.

lines.zh: 我的重量把周围压低了。
lines.en: My weight presses everything down.
Trying my first stretch.
It was quiet here before me.
Even the grass bends under my shadow.
Is this grove enough to feed me?
I swell slowly, like a rising tide.
Someone is knocking on my nest.
First I need somewhere to root.

lines.zh: 这块地的味道我还没尝过。
lines.en: I haven't tasted the smell of this ground yet.
I look up and can't see the sky.

lines.zh: 火焰在我潮湿的身体上冒白烟。
lines.en: Fire raises white steam off my wet body.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下来，散了半边。
lines.en: I crashed from height and half of me spread.

lines.zh: 水把我填满，我动不了了。
lines.en: Water fills me and I can't move.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的枝条全掀开了。
lines.en: The blast peeled all my branches open.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西扎进我的膜里。
lines.en: Something sharp pierced my membrane.

lines.zh: 咒力在我体内烧出一条路。
lines.en: The spell burned a path through me.
I haven't fed in a long time.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的身体钻到地面。
lines.en: Lightning ran down through me to the ground.
No soil beneath. Nothing to grip.
